div.head: Grið 21.1
div.ab: Ac þa ne beoð na wise ne fullice gescade, þe Gode nellað hyran ne bet understandan, hu oft he of lytlan arærde to miclan þa þe him hyrdan ⁊ mid rihte gecwemdon.
Ac þa ne beoð na wise ne fullice gescade, þe Gode nellað hyran ne bet understandan hu oft he of lytlan arærde to miclan þa þe him hyrdan and mid rihte gecwemdon.

Aber die sind keineswegs weise noch völlig klug, welche Gott nicht gehorchen noch besser begreifen wollen, wie oft er aus Kleinem zu Grossem diejenigen erhob, welche ihm gehorchten und richtiger Weise wohlgefällig waren.
But those are by no means wise nor fully prudent who will not obey God nor better understand how often he raised from small to great those who obeyed him and rightly pleased him.

Indeed, they are neither wise nor entirely perceptive who will not obey God nor better understand how often he has raised from insignificance to greatness those who obeyed him and pleased him rightly.
div.note: In G one letter is erased in the middle of ‘gecwe[m]don’.; T: corrected against Rabin, DOML 66 (2020), p. 28 (before: ‘Ac þa ne beoð na wise ne fullice gescade, þe Gode nellað hyran ne bet understandan hu oft he of lytlan arærde to miclan þa þe hira hyrdan and mid rihte gecwemdon.’)
